artists.biography:
The Black Crowes are an American rock band formed in 1989. Their discography includes nine studio albums, four live albums and several charting singles. The band was signed to Def American Recordings in 1989 by producer George Drakoulias and released their debut album, Shake Your Money Maker, the following year. The follow-up, The Southern Harmony and Musical Companion, reached the top of the Billboard 200 in 1992.

After a hiatus between 2002 and 2005, the band released Warpaint, which hit number 5 on the Billboard chart. After the release of a double album, the greatest hits-like and mostly acoustic Croweology in August 2010, the band started a 20th anniversary tour that was followed by an ongoing second hiatus.

The band has opened for various rock acts such as Heart, Robert Plant, Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers, the Dave Matthews Band, the Grateful Dead, Aerosmith and ZZ Top, and performed live with Jimmy Page and Oasis, among others. The band has sold over 30 million albums, and is listed at number 92 on VH1's "100 Greatest Artists of Hard Rock". They were also labeled by Melody Maker as "The Most Rock 'n' Roll Rock 'n' Roll Band in the World" and the readers of Rolling Stone voted them 'Best New American Band' in 1990.

perplexity.description:
Happiness Bastards is the tenth studio album by American rock band The Black Crowes, released on March 15, 2024, through Silver Arrow Records. Produced by Jay Joyce, the album marks the band’s first release of all-original material in 15 years, following their 2019 reformation and the departure of longtime drummer Steve Gorman. Musically, Happiness Bastards blends the band’s signature Southern rock roots with a fresh, contemporary edge, featuring bluesy guitar riffs, soulful vocals, and dynamic arrangements that showcase both their classic sound and evolution. The album includes a notable collaboration with country artist Lainey Wilson on the track “Wilted Rose,” adding a new dimension to their sonic palette.

In the context of The Black Crowes’ discography, Happiness Bastards stands as a significant milestone, representing a reunion of the Robinson brothers and a return to their creative core after years of hiatus and internal conflict. The album was met with critical acclaim, earning a nomination for Best Rock Album at the 67th Annual Grammy Awards, and was praised for its vitality and authenticity. Its release coincided with a major tour, reaffirming the band’s enduring influence and relevance in the rock genre.
